tokens.name: --bg
tokens.meaning: The page's base surface.

tokens.name: --bg-raised
tokens.meaning: A surface raised above the page, such as a card or panel.

tokens.name: --bg-sunken
tokens.meaning: A surface set into the page, such as a well or code block.

tokens.name: --fg
tokens.meaning: The main text colour.

tokens.name: --muted
tokens.meaning: Secondary text such as captions, hints and timestamps.

tokens.name: --border
tokens.meaning: Lines that separate or outline surfaces.

tokens.name: --accent
tokens.meaning: The interactive colour of links, focus and primary controls.

tokens.name: --accent-fg
tokens.meaning: Text and icons drawn on an accent fill.

tokens.name: --selected
tokens.meaning: The background of a selected item.

tokens.name: --radius
tokens.meaning: The corner radius of surfaces and controls.

tokens.name: --font-sans
tokens.meaning: The body typeface.

tokens.name: --font-mono
tokens.meaning: The monospaced typeface for code and identifiers.

tokens.name: --series-1
tokens.meaning: Categorical colour 1 of three, for kinds of thing shown together.

tokens.name: --series-2
tokens.meaning: Categorical colour 2 of three, for kinds of thing shown together.

tokens.name: --series-3
tokens.meaning: Categorical colour 3 of three, for kinds of thing shown together.

tokens.name: --state-active
tokens.meaning: The state colour of something in progress.

tokens.name: --state-quiet
tokens.meaning: The state colour of something idle, paused or waiting without need of attention.

tokens.name: --state-attention
tokens.meaning: The state colour of something that needs a person's attention.

tokens.name: --state-success
tokens.meaning: The state colour of something that ended well.

tokens.name: --state-failure
tokens.meaning: The state colour of something that ended in failure.

tokens.name: --state-halted
tokens.meaning: The state colour of something deliberately stopped before it ended.

tokens.name: --danger
tokens.meaning: Destructive actions and error text.

tokens.name: --warning-bg
tokens.meaning: The background of a warning notice.

tokens.name: --warning-fg
tokens.meaning: The text of a warning notice.

tokens.name: --glow
tokens.meaning: The glow around a primary action and an active navigation underline.

tokens.name: --glow-svg
tokens.meaning: The filter applied to a selected mark.

tokens.name: --accent-gradient
tokens.meaning: The fill of a primary action and an active navigation underline.

tokens.name: --font-display
tokens.meaning: The typeface of wordmarks, headings and counts.

tokens.name: --asset-backdrop
tokens.meaning: The image behind all content.

tokens.name: --asset-ornament
tokens.meaning: A small decorative image beside a wordmark or heading.

tokens.name: --asset-empty
tokens.meaning: The illustration shown where there is nothing to show.

tokens.name: --asset-opacity
tokens.meaning: The opacity of the backdrop and ornament images.
